## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle compendium by [元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89) Wǒnhyo treats the doctrinal essence (*zōng yào*) of *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 ([KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001)) — paralleling Wǒnhyo's *Liǎng juàn wú liàng shòu jīng zōng yào* 兩卷無量壽經宗要 ([KR6f0067](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0067), T1747) and other *zōng yào* compendia.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (660–686) reflects Wǒnhyo's mature Silla period.
